registered_before: Original dependency export or any post-chain numerical computation. Original registration remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
reason: Include the explicitly requested CLI/API source and tests in the exact additive source manifest before integrating any new source. Artifact-only commits remain allowed; scientific paths remain exact and clean.

terminal_contract.success: PASS/COMPLETE with exit_code0, outputs_complete true, nonempty expected_outputs and artifact_hashes; all paths relative to main repo and all hashes/coverage checked.
terminal_contract.single_pipeline: Each new study owns one fresh run root and final terminal; write-once internal phase proofs are allowed. Unsupported phase-only launches refuse lease/score bypass.
terminal_contract.G0_receipt: Publish only after successful terminal/released-lease evidence; bind their raw hashes and recompute original comparisons at consumption. No circular self hashes.

producer_api: validate_consumer_terminal(root,registration_path,output_dir,*,expected_binary_sha256=None)->metadata-only raw source/command/exit/coverage/hash/reservation/released-lease proof; sealed targets remain undecoded. Required producer artifacts and all governing receipts/manifests must be committed clean before downstream compute.
